column1: # Products the daily report watches closely.
# name<TAB>keywords<TAB>GitHub advisory ecosystems for high-severity items ('-' for none)<TAB>core pattern ('-' for none)
# Keywords match whole words, case-insensitive: a hit means the CVE MENTIONS the product.
# The optional core pattern (a Python regex, case-insensitive) decides whether the CVE is ABOUT the product itself.
# Only core hits raise alerts, so a WordPress plugin that says 'PHP' does not look like a PHP vulnerability.
# Products without a core pattern treat every mention as core.
